title: The North Gate
description: A gatehouse of black stone squats over the only road into Gallowmere. The portcullis is raised, rusted in place, and an old gibbet creaks from the arch above it. Beyond the walls the moor is lost in grey fog. The road runs south into town.

features.name: the gibbet
features.look: An iron cage hangs from a chain over the arch. Whoever was in it last has been gone a while. Mostly.

actions.touch: The cage swings at your touch and creaks loud enough to make the guard look up.
actions.take: It's chained to the arch, twenty feet up. Even if you could reach it, where would you put it?
actions.climb: You get a hand on the arch stones and think better of it. The guard is watching, and the cage is not quite empty enough.

features.name: the portcullis
features.look: Rust has welded the portcullis open. Nobody has closed this gate in years, and nobody seems keen to try.

actions.touch: Cold iron, rough with rust. It hasn't moved in years.
actions.push: You heave at the portcullis. It doesn't so much as rattle.
actions.climb: You climb a few bars, see nothing but fog in every direction, and climb back down.

title: Gate Road
description: Cart ruts have worn the cobbles into a muddy trough. Shuttered houses lean over the road as if listening. The watch barracks lie west, steps climb east toward the temple, and the market noise drifts up from the south.

features.name: the shuttered houses
features.look: Tall narrow houses with every shutter closed. One shutter twitches as you look, then goes still.

actions.push: You knock on a shutter. Inside, someone holds their breath until you leave.
actions.open: The shutters are barred from the inside. Of course they are.

title: Barracks Yard
description: A packed dirt yard where the town watch drills when it can be bothered. A notice board is papered with old bounties, most of them torn or rained into pulp. A stocks stands empty in one corner, its wood polished by unhappy necks.

features.name: the notice board
features.look: Old bounties, mostly rotted to pulp. One fresh notice reads: WANTED, the rat that ate the captain's boots. Reward negotiable.

actions.read: WANTED: the rat that ate the captain's boots. WANTED: whoever keeps writing on this board. NOTICE: the watch does not take bribes. Under that, in another hand: ask for Dace.
actions.take: You tear the fresh notice down, feel the eyes of the empty barracks on your back, and pin it up again.

features.name: the stocks
features.look: A wooden stocks with holes for head and hands, polished smooth by the unlucky. Somebody has carved WORTH IT into the frame.

actions.sit: You settle into the stocks and rest your neck in the groove. It's oddly comfortable. That's the worrying part.
actions.touch: The wood is smooth as glass from all the necks.
actions.take: It's bolted to the yard. And heavy. And a stocks.

title: Temple Steps
description: Worn steps rise toward a squat temple of soot stained stone. Beggars have claimed the lower steps; the upper ones are kept clear by long habit and a short temper. Gate Road lies to the west.

features.name: the beggars
features.look: A row of beggars in grey rags, rattling cups at anyone who climbs past. They watch the temple doors more than they watch you.

actions.touch: The nearest beggar flinches away. "Coin, not hands," he says.
actions.search: Rummaging through beggars is a good way to get stabbed with a spoon. You leave it.
actions.take: Take a beggar? Nobody in this town comes that cheap.

title: The Temple of Ash
description: Cold air and the smell of old candles. Ash from a thousand offerings lies in drifts beneath a cracked altar, and a painted saint watches from the far wall with her eyes scratched out. Healing is sold here, they say, to those who can pay.

features.name: the altar
features.look: A cracked stone altar heaped with grey ash. A brass bowl beside it is marked OFFERINGS, and it is chained down.

actions.touch: Ash coats your fingers. It's softer than it should be.
actions.search: You sift the ash. A tooth, two buttons and a copper so worn the face is gone. You leave them be. It feels like the right thing.
actions.take: The ash is the saint's, the bowl is chained, and the altar weighs as much as a horse.

features.name: the painted saint
features.look: A faded saint in a blue robe, her eyes scratched out long ago. Someone has painted a small smile back onto her mouth.

actions.touch: The paint is cold and a little tacky, as if someone touched up that smile recently.
actions.take: She's painted on the wall. She isn't going anywhere, and neither are her eyes.

title: Smithy Row
description: Heat rolls out of an open forge, and the hammer rings from dawn until well past sensible hours. Half finished blades hang from hooks along the wall. The market lies east.

features.name: the forge
features.look: A roaring forge, hot enough to make your eyes water from the doorway.

actions.touch: You reach toward the forge and the heat slaps your hand back. Good call.
actions.use: You give the bellows one pump. The fire roars. The blacksmith's look says do that again and lose the hand.

features.name: the half finished blades
features.look: Rough blades waiting for edges and hilts. None of them are for sale. Yet.

actions.take: You reach for a blade. The hammer stops. You put it back. The hammer starts again.
actions.touch: No edge on them yet. Give it a week.

title: Market West
description: Stalls of patched canvas crowd the west end of the market, selling rope, lamp oil and things that fell off other people's carts. A painted rat hangs over a low doorway to the south: The Drowned Rat. Smithy Row lies west.

features.name: the stalls
features.look: Rope, lamp oil, bent nails, a single boot. Every stallholder swears their goods came by honestly.

actions.search: You poke through the stalls: rope, oil, a single boot. The stallholder watches you like you're the thief.
actions.take: The stallholder's hand lands on yours before you've lifted anything. "Coin first."

features.name: the painted rat sign
features.look: A wooden sign of a rat with its paws crossed over its chest, floating belly up. THE DROWNED RAT, it says, in case you missed the point.

actions.push: You swat the sign. It swings, and for a second the drowned rat seems to wink at you.
actions.take: You'd need a ladder, and a much better reason.

title: Market Square
description: The heart of Gallowmere, such as it is. A dry fountain holds a statue of some forgotten founder, his nose long since knocked off. Hawkers shout over each other, pickpockets work the crowd, and the town crier's platform stands empty for now. Roads lead in every direction.

features.name: the dry fountain
features.look: A dry fountain choked with rubbish. The founder's statue has lost its nose, and pigeons have claimed the rest.

actions.search: You dig through the rubbish in the bowl: a bent spoon, a letter too wet to read and one very surprised frog.
actions.climb: You clamber onto the founder's shoulders. The view is fog, roofs and more fog. A hawker applauds anyway.
actions.use: You try to drink from the fountain. It's dry, unless you count the rubbish.

features.name: the crier's platform
features.look: An empty wooden platform where the town crier shouts the news. A scrap of paper nailed to it says BACK SOON.

actions.climb: You climb onto the crier's platform. A few faces turn up, hoping for news. You have none. They turn away.
actions.read: BACK SOON, says the note. Someone has scratched a date under it. Three years ago.

title: Market East
description: Grocers and fishmongers hold the east end of the market, and the smell holds everyone else. Baskets of grey turnips sit beside eels that are still deciding whether to die. Market Square lies west.

features.name: the eels
features.look: A barrel of river eels, still twitching. The fishmonger insists that means they are fresh.

actions.take: You grab an eel. The eel disagrees, strongly, and wins.
actions.touch: Slimy, cold and very much alive.
actions.smell: Fresh, the fishmonger says. Your nose says otherwise.

title: The Drowned Rat
description: A low ceilinged tavern, warm and loud and sticky underfoot. Smoke hangs under the beams, dice rattle in a corner, and a long scarred bar runs the length of the room. A stained curtain hangs on the west wall, and nobody looks at it for long. The door north leads back to the market.

features.name: the stained curtain
features.look: A heavy curtain, stained with things best left unnamed. A draught stirs it now and then, as if there were a room behind it.

open.text: You pull the curtain aside. Behind it, a cramped storeroom of barrels and sacks. You could slip through to the west.
open.room: pulls the stained curtain aside and peers behind it.
open.event: pulls your stained curtain aside and peers into your back room

take.text: You grab a fistful of curtain and give it a good yank. It holds. Every head in the tavern turns.
take.room: yanks hard on the stained curtain.
take.event: grabs your stained curtain and tries to yank it down

actions.touch: Heavy, stiff with old spills and smoke. A cold draught leaks through from the west.

features.name: the dice game
features.look: A knot of drinkers hunched over a battered cup of dice. They stop talking when you get close.

use.text: You lean in to join the game. The players close ranks without looking up. Locals only, apparently.
use.room: tries to join the dice game and gets frozen out.

take.text: You scoop up the dice. Every player at the table goes very still. You put them back.
take.room: scoops up the dice from the game, then puts them back.
take.event: snatches the dice off your regulars' table, then puts them back

title: The Back Room
description: Behind the curtain, a cramped storeroom of barrels and sacks. One barrel is not like the others: it has a ledger tucked behind it, wrapped in oilcloth. The tavern lies east.

features.name: the oilcloth ledger
features.look: A ledger wrapped in oilcloth, full of neat columns of debts. Most of the pages are signed with a small drawing of a hook.

actions.read: Columns of debts, all owed to someone who signs with a small hook. The biggest line on the last page is in a heavy hand: The Drowned Rat, everything.
actions.take: You tuck the ledger under your arm, think about Morda, the docks and that little hook, and put it back exactly where it was.

features.name: the barrels
features.look: Ale barrels, flour sacks and a crate marked TURNIPS that is suspiciously heavy.

actions.search: Ale, flour and a crate marked TURNIPS full of something wrapped in sacking that is definitely not turnips. You decide you never saw it.
actions.open: You lever the lid off the turnip crate. Not turnips. You put the lid back very carefully.
actions.use: You put your mouth under an ale tap. Warm, flat, and still better than the river.

title: Wet Lane
description: A narrow lane that is never dry, sloping down toward the river. Water drips from every gutter and collects in black puddles. Somebody is always sleeping in a doorway here. The market is north, the docks south.

features.name: the black puddles
features.look: Puddles of black water that never dry. Something glints at the bottom of one, then it is gone.

actions.search: You reach into the black water. Your fingers close on something small and round, then it slips away. A coin. Probably.

title: Docks Stair
description: Slick stone stairs drop to the riverside. The river is wide and brown and in no hurry. East, boats knock against the docks; west, a rusted grate breathes foul air out of the town wall.

features.name: the river
features.look: Wide, brown and slow. Things float by now and then, and it is best not to look too closely at them.

actions.touch: Cold, brown and slow. Something brushes your fingers and you pull back fast.
actions.use: You cup your hands, look at the water, and think better of drinking it. Wise.

title: River Docks
description: Rotting piers and fishing boats with names painted over other names. Crates are stacked high and watched closely by men who say they are not watching anything. The harbourmaster's shed is shut up tight.

features.name: the stacked crates
features.look: Crates stamped with the marks of a dozen ports, several of them crossed out. A man nearby suddenly finds the sky very interesting.

actions.open: You get a fingernail under a lid. A man appears at your elbow. "Wrong crate, friend." You agree that it is.
actions.read: Port stamps from everywhere, half of them crossed out. One crate says FRAGILE in three languages and has been dropped in all of them.
actions.take: Too heavy to lift alone, and far too watched to try with help.

features.name: the harbourmaster's shed
features.look: A tarred wooden shed, locked tight. A sign on the door says CLOSED in large letters and BRIBES TUESDAYS in small ones.

actions.open: Locked. Bribes are Tuesdays, says the sign. Today is not Tuesday.
actions.push: You knock. Something heavy shifts inside, then goes very quiet.

title: The Sewer Grate
description: A great iron grate set into the base of the wall, where the town empties itself into the river. The bars are bent wide enough for a thin person, or a large rat. Something down there is scratching. The stair lies east.

features.name: the iron grate
features.look: Thick iron bars, bent apart by something strong or someone stubborn. A foul warm breath rises from the dark beyond.

actions.touch: Slimy bars, bent wide enough for someone thin. The air coming through is warm and foul.
actions.climb: You get a shoulder between the bars. Below, something squeals, then a lot of somethings. Not today. Not without a light and a blade.
